name: M2 — Tasks on mobile: board list → board → task
description:
MILESTONE M2 (blocked: needs M1 + strategy decision).
Vertical slice: "from the phone I can open a board, read its columns and open a task".

SCOPE
- Kanban on small screens: board list, open one board, columns as a horizontal or stacked reading pattern, task card, open task.
- Reuse the existing route /:projectName/kanban/:board?/:boardName? and the apps registry entry 'tasks' (see src/config/apps.js) instead of a mobile-only path.
- Board identity must survive refresh (board param already in the route — verify it round-trips).
- No drag & drop requirement on mobile; define what replaces it (move-to-column action) and implement the minimum.

OUT OF SCOPE
Task edition forms, planning view, files view of the board.

DEPLOYABLE + DEMOABLE
Demo: real board with real cards → open a task → back to the board on a phone.

ACCEPTANCE
- A phone user can go from Home to a task in ≤ 3 taps.
- No horizontal overflow, no clipped columns at 375 px.
- Board opened in a URL survives a page refresh.
